changelog: 🔒 Enterprise On-Device Security & AES-256-GCM Vault: Hardware-salted on-device encryption for all API keys, tokens, and SSH credentials. Frontend secret masking, strict TLS/HTTPS transport, prompt sanitization/XSS protection, and zero secret leakage in logs.
🛡️ Sovereign Privacy Policy & Terms of Service: Dedicated in-app dialogs guaranteeing 100% on-device data sovereignty, zero telemetry, zero tracking, and local sandboxing.

📁 Fresh Mobile Folder Creation & Quick Storage Chips: '+ New Folder' dialog to create brand new directories in Termux or phone storage (/storage/emulated/0), with 1-tap jump chips for Projects, Termux, Phone Storage, Documents, and Downloads.
⚡ 4MB Ultra High-Speed Stream Buffer: Boosted download engine to 4MB chunked stream buffers with rolling throughput measurement, achieving high-speed 20-30+ MB/s downloads.

🎛️ Unlimited PC Power Features & Guidance Cards: Comprehensive suite of 45+ PC tools with full instructions on what each does ('টুলের কাজ কি'), what happens when activated ('অন করলে কি হইবো'), and how to use it ('কীভাবে ব্যবহার করবেন').
🔋 Hardware, Thermal & Idle Governor: CPU core and RAM cache customization, thermal hardware protection, and background idle runtime limiters to protect mobile battery and performance.
🌐 Autonomous Sidebar Browser Agent Control: Full AI agent browser automation via local MCP server (DOM inspection, clicks, form fills, screenshots, tab management).
📦 Dual Flavor Release: jin-termux and jin-standard APKs with persistent release signing.
